notes:
A small update that makes controller problems reportable.

If you have told me your controller connects but does nothing in PPSSPP, this build is
what lets me finish that one. Your controller report now includes what PPSSPP and
DraStic actually saw of your controllers, which buttons PPSSPP has bound, and which
version of the launcher you are running. Before, the report showed your controller
setup and nothing about the emulator, which is why several reports could not be
answered.

Nothing about how your console plays changes in this update.

If your controller does not work in PPSSPP, please send a fresh report. The order
matters, because the report reads the emulator's own log: update, start your PSP game,
try the controller, and then send the report from Settings.
